recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Treat related AllergyIntolerance status datatype work and later Condition terminology/value-set requests as separate trackers rather than changing this already-applied Condition datatype decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16193 asked to change Condition.clinicalStatus and Condition.verificationStatus from code to CodeableConcept so implementations can carry the required FHIR value set code plus translations, text, and more specific codings such as SNOMED CT.
initial_application: The historical commit 8fa342565e4257941f388ece874b02f4f9c9f43f explicitly applied GF#16193 by changing the Condition spreadsheet and examples to CodeableConcept forms. Later source refactors preserved GF#16193 committee notes in the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml and the Condition examples are in current build scope. FHIR-19633 later added comments explaining the CodeableConcept rationale, FHIR-16190 kept verificationStatus binding required because CodeableConcept allows additional codings, and FHIR-54914 clarified verificationStatus comments while keeping the datatype unchanged.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current StructureDefinition declares both status elements as CodeableConcept, comments still explain the additional-coding rationale, and current Condition examples no longer use obsolete scalar clinicalStatus or verificationStatus values.

related_jiras.note: Added explanatory comments after GF#16193 and GF#17743 changed Condition and AllergyIntolerance statuses to CodeableConcept.
Rejected loosening Condition.verificationStatus binding because CodeableConcept can carry both the required FHIR code and additional codings.
Clarified the Condition.verificationStatus CodeableConcept comment in R6 without changing the datatype.
Later no-change decision about latent clinicalStatus values noted existing CodeableConcept extensibility and did not reverse FHIR-16193.
